_about: PONY FAMILIES (locked 2026-11-14 batch 6, diary/DECISIONS_SEA.md: more variety inside pony, no tier above it). Every pony gun belongs to one family: its skin's colours (game/pony_skin.gd: hue = the middle of its colours 0..1, span = how far they swing, sat = how strong) and ONE of its two traits comes from the family's own pony-only traits (data/gun_traits.json, field family); the other trait is from the common pool. Names, colours and numbers are my placeholders for the director.
